description.value: You can use the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Aid] reaction to help an ally, even if you haven't prepared to do so. If one or more of your allies are your employees, after you Aid an ally at a skill check that doesn't have the attack trait, you can also Aid any other ally who's also one of your employees who attempts the same skill check for the same purpose that round as a free action rather than a reaction. An ally is also your employee as long as they spend at least one day of Downtime per week @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Earn Income]{Earning Income} on behalf of your company. They keep any income they earn, but on a Critical Failure your company's reputation might suffer.
